snippet.description:
Join Santosh Sir for Environment Lecture 1 under the Mains Master Program (MMP) for UPSC CSE 2027. Build your understanding of environment-related topics relevant to UPSC preparation and GS Mains.

Watch the live session to strengthen your conceptual clarity and prepare for the UPSC Civil Services Examination 2027.

𝐓𝐨𝐝𝐚𝐲'𝐬 𝐇𝐚𝐧𝐝𝐨𝐮𝐭: https://t.me/Santoshkumarcurrentaffairs/12722 

Enrollment Open in Mains Master Program (MMP) 2027: https://shorturl.at/KMn2Y
📲Queries? Call directly- 8826496658

🔍Get a FREE 1-to-1 Mentorship Session with real teachers and senior mentors: https://shorturl.at/uBnu0

Meet us 📍 at LevelUp IAS, Karol Bagh Centre
Google Map - https://maps.app.goo.gl/NvPyzytSwDQYEu8PA
Address - 2nd Floor, 45 Pusa Road, Opp. Metro Pillar 128, Karol Bagh
